title: The first Muslims
subject: Islamic Studies
unit: Summer 1: The mission in Makkah and the Hijrah
source: Seeded from islamic-studies/y2 lesson 7 (Pupil PDF worksheet: the first Muslims)
intro: Lesson 7: The first revelation and the early Muslims. To understand how the revelation began and how the first Muslims believed and invited others with patience

questions.q: Who was the first person to believe?
questions.model: Teacher: 'He came home from Hira and told his wife first. She believed him straight away: Khadijah.'

questions.q: Where did the first revelation come?
On the pupil PDF, write or say one kind thing each early Muslim did: Khadijah comforted; Abu Bakr invited his friends; Ali believed young.
questions.model: Teacher writes: 'Khadijah comforted the Prophet ﷺ and believed him.'

questions.q: how can we invite a friend to something good kindly?
questions.a: Use gentle words, smile, be patient

questions.q: The first word sent down was ...
Back to our ponder: who did the Prophet ﷺ tell first?
